intent: Make an expense tracker web app where I can add expenses by category and see a pie chart.

spec.goal: Have an expense tracker web app where expenses can be added by category and viewed in a pie chart.
spec.deliverable: A working expense tracker web app with an expense entry form and a pie chart of spending by category.
constraints: The user must be able to add expenses and assign each one to a category.
The app must display a pie chart showing expenses broken down by category.
Do not add features beyond adding expenses by category and the pie chart.
done_criteria: A user can add an expense with an amount and a category.
The pie chart shows spending split by category.
The pie chart updates when a new expense is added.
spec.summary: You want a web app for tracking expenses where you can add each expense under a category and see how your spending is split in a pie chart.
